# How loops form within the unfolding / 回路怎样在展开中形成

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`how-loops-form` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](how-loops-form.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A loop forms by closing: the loops formed by T + 1 are those formed by T and those through a coupling acting at T that closes a chain; before it forms growth is polynomial and does not show it will; with strengths read off the course, formation is read off the unfolding.
>
> 回路由闭合而形成：到 T + 1 形成的回路，是到 T 形成的回路与经过在第 T 步作用、闭合一条链的耦合的回路；形成之前增长至多是多项式，且不显示它是否将形成；强度从进程读出时，进程是其所读强度的所携带的量，回路的形成从展开读出。

## Laws / 规律

1. The strengths before step T keep the couplings acting before T and drop the rest; its couplings are exactly those acting at some step before T, and they rise with T. The loops formed by T are its loops; every chain of couplings is formed by some step, so a world's loops are exactly the loops formed by some step, and likewise what lies upstream.<br>第 T 步之前的强度保留在 T 之前作用的耦合、去掉其余；它的耦合恰是在 T 之前某步作用的耦合，随 T 上升。到 T 形成的回路就是它的回路；每条耦合的链都在某步形成，所以一个世界的回路恰是到某步形成的回路，上游亦然。 (`Becoming.Closing.ble_false_of_lt`, `Becoming.strengthsBefore`, `Becoming.strengthsBefore_before`, `Becoming.strengthsBefore_from`, `Becoming.strengthsBefore_le`, `Becoming.couplesAt_before_iff`, `Becoming.couples_before_iff`, `Becoming.couples_before_mono`, `Becoming.couples_of_before`, `Becoming.couples_before_of_couplesAt`, `Becoming.Coupled.lift`, `Becoming.OnLoop.lift`, `Becoming.Upstream.lift`, `Becoming.coupled_formed`, `Becoming.onLoop_iff_formed`, `Becoming.upstream_iff_formed`)
2. A loop forms by closing: the loops formed by T + 1 are the loops formed by T and those through a coupling acting at step T that closes a chain, reading a level of d and giving to c, with chains from c through the loop's condition to d. So a loop that forms passes through a coupling acting at the step it forms; an exchange coming to respond to the level of the condition it gives to forms a loop of one. Chains join, and a coupling with chains into and out of a condition closes a loop through it.<br>回路由闭合而形成：到 T + 1 形成的回路，是到 T 形成的回路，以及经过一个在第 T 步作用、闭合一条链的耦合的回路，它读 d 的水平、给 c，而已有链从 c 经回路的条件通到 d。所以一个形成的回路经过在它形成之步作用的耦合；一个交换开始回应它所给的条件的水平，形成一圈的回路。链可以接合；有链进出一个条件的耦合闭合经过它的回路。 (`Becoming.Closing.join`, `Becoming.Closing.join_below`, `Becoming.Closing.join_from`, `Becoming.Coupled.append`, `Becoming.Coupled.one`, `Becoming.onLoop_of_closing`, `Becoming.Upstream.refl`, `Becoming.Closing.split`, `Becoming.onLoop_succ_iff`, `Becoming.forms_by_closing`, `Becoming.responds_to_own_level`)
3. The carried amount up to step T reads only the couplings acting before T. So with every condition listed and no loop formed by T upstream, the carried amount at every step up to T is at most a polynomial in the steps, of degree one less than the number of conditions, whatever the couplings do later.<br>到第 T 步所携带的量只读在 T 之前作用的耦合。所以条件全部列出、到 T 形成的回路都不在上游时，到 T 的每步所携带的量至多是步数的多项式，次数比条件数少一，不论此后耦合怎样。 (`Becoming.carriedGive_congr_strength`, `Becoming.carried_before`, `Becoming.inflow_before_le`, `Becoming.carried_le_polynomial_before`)
4. The amounts before a loop forms do not show whether it will: a self-loop of strength one forming at step T carries the starting gap unchanged up to T and doubles it at every step after; it forms at T and not before; and a loop forming at any later step carries the same amounts up to T.<br>形成之前的量不显示它是否将形成：在第 T 步形成的强度为一的自环，到 T 为止保持起始之差不变，此后每步加倍；它在 T 形成，之前没有；在任何更晚的步形成的回路，到 T 为止携带同样的量。 (`Becoming.Closing.Onset.strengths`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.amount`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.strengths_early`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.strengths_late`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.amount_succ_early`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.amount_succ_late`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.amount_before`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.amount_after`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.forms`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.not_formed`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.unforeseen`)
5. Where a law's strengths at each step are read from the levels up to that step only, the law giving what its read strengths make of the levels reads what has stood, and the course it generates is the carried amount of the strengths it reads: which loops form, and when, is read off the unfolding.<br>一个律每步的强度只从至该步的水平读出时，给出其读出强度对水平所作者的律读已立者，它生成的进程就是它所读强度的所携带的量：哪些回路形成、何时形成，从展开读出。 (`Becoming.ReadsBefore`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.carryingRead`, `Becoming.formedCourse`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.carryingRead_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.formedCourse_succ`, `Becoming.formedCourse_eq_carried`)
6. The threshold witness: the part gives one unit at each step, and the exchange of the formation outside it with the condition responds to its level once that level has reached θ. The level is t up to θ; the loop forms at step θ and not before; from then the level plus one doubles at every step; and up to θ the course is the same for every threshold beyond it.<br>阈值的见证：部分每步给一个单位，部分之外的形成与这个条件的交换在其水平达到 θ 后回应它。水平到 θ 为止是 t；回路在第 θ 步形成，之前没有；此后水平加一每步加倍；到 θ 为止，对 θ 之外的每个阈值进程相同。 (`Becoming.Closing.Threshold.reading`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.reads`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.strengths`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.strengths_eq`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level_succ`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level_before`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level_le_succ`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level_ge`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level_after`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.not_formed`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.forms`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.unforeseen`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom. What each theorem needs is written into it: the strengths k as supplied bounds, or strengths κ read from the levels up to each step (ReadsBefore); in the polynomial bound, every condition listed, the part giving no gap after the start, starting gaps at most D and the strengths into each condition at most M a step.<br>不加公理。各定理所写者写在定理中：强度 k 是给出的界，或强度 κ 从至每步的水平读出（ReadsBefore）；多项式之界中条件全部列出、部分在起始之后不给差、起始之差至多 D、每步进入每个条件的强度至多 M。

## Does not show / 未表明

- That the closing coupling did not act before T: selecting such a coupling would need a decision of whether a coupling acted before T, and the core assumes no excluded middle; the theorem says it acts at step T.<br>闭合的耦合在 T 之前不作用：要挑出这样的耦合需要判定一个耦合在 T 之前是否作用，核心不假定排中律；定理只说它在第 T 步作用。
- Which strengths a world reads off its course; when loops of read strengths form, for every law.<br>一个世界从其进程读出哪些强度；对一切律刻画读出强度的回路何时形成。
- A runaway after formation for every law: what doubles is the most difference that can arrive (the self-loop and threshold witnesses), not every law's actual gap.<br>形成之后的失控对每个律：加倍的是能到达的最大差别（自环与阈值的见证），不是每个律的实际之差。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** A self-loop forming at step T and one forming later carry the same amounts up to T, after which one doubles: no bound on what follows comes from the amounts before formation.<br>在第 T 步形成的自环与在更晚的步形成的自环，到 T 为止携带同样的量，此后一个加倍：形成之前的量推不出此后的界。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Closing.lean)

### Correspondence / 对应

On 16 October 2026 Ren took P118's third reading in its refined form, “which loops a world has is part of its situation; loops form and dissolve within the unfolding, and the theorems take them as they stand at each step”, and said “leave it pending until a loop-formation theorem exists”; the same day Ren asked for “a theorem showing how loops form within the unfolding … let's finish both”. This result is that theorem. Readings (the AI's, agreed by Ren on 16 October 2026): loops form within the unfolding by closing, at the step some exchange comes to respond to a level downstream of the condition it gives to; with strengths read off the course the loops are part of what the unfolding forms; a loop's formation is not foreseen from the amounts before it, which meets Becoming.Runaway: what registers it is what registers the couplings themselves. How loops dissolve is P120's (couplings that stop).<br>Ren 2026-10-16 取了 P118 第三项读法的精炼形式：“一个世界有哪些回路是其情境的一部分；回路在展开中形成与消解，定理按每步所立者取之”，并说“leave it pending until a loop-formation theorem exists”；同日说“a theorem showing how loops form within the unfolding … let's finish both”。本结果是那条定理。读法（AI 的，Ren 2026-10-16 同意）：回路在展开中由闭合而形成，在某个交换开始回应它所给的条件下游的一个水平之步；强度从进程读出时回路是展开所形成的一部分；回路的形成不从它之前的量预见，这与 Becoming.Runaway 相遇：能识它的是识耦合本身者。回路的消解见 P120（停止的耦合）。
